name: mios_task_record
description: One line of tasks.jsonl at the MiOS repo root, the only canonical MiOS task list (ADR-0028, supersedes ADR-0026). The path comes from mios.toml [tasks.store].path. Lines are serialized like Python json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False): separators ', ' and ': ', keys in the order of 'required' below, so the dev-loop toolkit and mios-task rewrite a line identically. Status words are the OpenAI plan statuses. A record is an OpenAI-style object: an opaque id task_<ULID>, object "task" and a creation-order number; people, TASKS.md and every file outside the structured fields name a task by its typed id task_<number>. Overrides are not part of a record: they are JSON lines in the TASKS.md overrides block, each an id (typed or opaque) plus record fields applied on top of the record. A list mios-task migrate-ids has not migrated yet (mios.toml [tasks.store] has no numbered) is read with the legacy shape mios-task keeps: verbatim ids, provenance.key and provenance.aliases, no object or number.

id.description: Opaque OpenAI-style id: task_ and a ULID (26 Crockford base32 characters, a 48-bit millisecond timestamp then 80 bits). Minted once by mios-task add or migrate-ids and never reused; ids sort in number order. Structured references (depends_on, epic, related) use it.

object.description: The OpenAI object type. The typed id is <object>_<number>.

number.description: Creation order from 1, unique and never reissued: the store's highest number may not fall below mios.toml [tasks.store].numbered. The typed id task_<number> is how TASKS.md, prose and every other file name the task.

type.description: The retired store type roadmap_item maps to task; the original type is kept in provenance.type_raw.

owner.description: Lane claim such as claude-code, lane-b or Codex. An empty string means unclaimed. Never free-form 'Who' text.

epic.description: The opaque id of an epic record, or an empty string.

depends_on.description: Blocking edges only, by opaque id. Every entry must resolve to an id in the file.

id.description: The opaque id of the related record.

type.description: archived: an edge the dev-loop toolkit took out of depends_on (archived_dependencies) because its target was archived; history, never a block.

verification_evidence.description: Must be non-empty when status is completed.

provenance.description: null for a record created in tasks.jsonl; such a record must have non-empty acceptance_criteria plus verification.positive_cmd and verification.negative_control_cmd. A migrated record carries where it came from and every byte it owned in the retired lists, each old task id in that text rewritten to its typed id by mios-task migrate-ids; git history keeps the bytes from before.

owner_raw.description: The store's 'Who' text; never a lane claim

sources.description: The slices of the retired lists this record owned, in file order, with old task ids rewritten to typed ids. Concatenated by offset, the slices of every record rebuild each file of mios.toml [tasks.store].frozen byte for byte (mios-task source).

offset.description: Byte offset of the slice in its file

after.description: The typed id of the record that owns the slice just before this one in the same file; empty for the first slice. Names a dropped record.
